method: Independent WK-only cross-audit. Exact source/review case-ID equality, status, approved runtime claim-ref resolution, and a diverse 20-case central-relevance/boundedness sample were checked. Scenario facts establish local state. Missing authoritative stock, ownership, exact price/rate/unit, law, route, identity, outcome, or NPC choice is out of scope, not a corpus gap.

audit_sample.reasoning: Visible condition and available repeated weighing support bounded comparison; authenticity, value, acceptance, and settlement remain unresolved.
Wood response plus labour/material trade-off supports inspection before repair-versus-replacement; no preferred outcome is asserted.
Cross-material moisture and odour sensitivity directly supports conditional separation without inferring contamination or room capacity.
Claims centrally support dividing, separating, and cushioning mixed cargo; boat capacity and successful transport are not claimed.
Parties, basis, transferred goods, and later settlement are proper record facts; record is not given legal force.
Mechanical grain transformation and moisture-sensitive deformation support possible fractions and losses without a yield or mill state.
Feed, shelter, animal condition, and workload are central care constraints; no stock, ration, or animal state is invented.
Fibre direction and moisture support conditional timber assessment; knots and required service remain scene-specific inspection facts.
Wet cut crops create a bounded preservation and labour-priority question; loss, schedule, and available shelter are not inferred.
External package condition and bounded sample comparison allow inspection while preserving uncertainty about hidden contents and deceit.
Observable usefulness and condition support a general suitability check; price, provenance, and availability remain excluded.
Storage separation and moisture-sensitive condition support bounded reserve handling without quantity or duration.
All named qualitative exchange factors are directly covered; no rate, consent, or result follows.
Weather, work pressure, available people, and means support conditional ordering of tasks, not a universal calendar.
Separate reserve and condition-aware storage are central; reserve size, owner, and household decision remain open.
Conditional handling supports balancing access, protection, and carrying load without a route, inventory, or outcome.
Competing household work and available means support flexible sequencing; no mandatory order is imposed.
Visible description and sample limits support bounded product description without price, provenance, guarantee, or quality verdict.
Conditional protection and priority of work cover weather response without inventing forecast, buildings, or supplies.
Present-versus-future use and qualitative effort/risk comparison are covered; household decision remains unchosen.
